summary.text: Marc Lombardo is a Republican state representative from the 22nd Middlesex District who has served since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked as a software sales account manager.

paragraphs.text: Marc Lombardo earned a B.S. in business administration from Merrimack College and has attended the MBA program at the University of Massachusetts Lowell, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as a sales account manager at Saba Software.
Lombardo assumed office in the Massachusetts House in 2011.

For 2025-2026 he was ranking minority member of the Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity and of the Revenue Joint Committee, and was also assigned to the Election Laws Joint Committee and the Human Resources and Employee Engagement Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.
